name: Fountain of Blossoms
description: The spell that almost got her exiled. It turns any water source into a geyser of blossoms: beautiful, fragrant, and absolutely catastrophic for water quality. She casts it only when she is very sure the water does not matter.

params.message: A fountain of blossoms erupts from the ground, glorious and overwhelming.
The area is drenched in floral sweetness and soft light.

params.text: The whole place is pink and white and dripping with petals, and the elders are definitely going to notice.
params.message: The world turns pink and white. The elders are definitely going to notice.
